subject: english
question:
**Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence.**

You told me that you had made all the plans and my trip would be very smooth and that you had confirmed tickets for all my flights.

options.text: You said to me, “I’ve made all the plans and your trip will be very smooth. I have confirmed tickets for all your flights.”
You said to me, “I’ve made all the plans and your trip would be very smooth. You have confirmed tickets for all your flights.”
You said to me, “You have made all the plans and your trip will be very smooth. You have confirmed tickets for all your flights.”
You said to him, “I’ve made all the plans and his trip will be very smooth. I had confirmed tickets for all the flights!”

solution:
The correct answer is: **You said to me, “I’ve made all the plans and your trip will be very smooth. I have confirmed tickets for all your flights.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'told' changes to 'said to' in the direct speech part.
 
• The conjunction 'that' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• The modal 'would' in the indirect part changes to 'will' in the direct speech part.
 
• If the indirect speech is written in the **Past Perfect tense**, then we have to change it into the **Present Perfect tense**. Therefore, **"had made"** changes to **"have made"** and **"had confirmed"** changes to **"have confirmed"**
 
• The pronoun 'you' changes to 'I' and 'my' changes to 'your' in the direct speech part.
 
 

Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

Hence, direct speech is - *You said to me, “I’ve made all the plans and your trip will be very smooth. I have confirmed tickets for all your flights.”*
